```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
```

# A header

Regular text

```{r}
dat <- read.table("data/dat_sossap.csv",
                  sep="\t",
                  header=TRUE)
```

Number of rows: `r nrow(dat)`
Number of columns: `r ncol(dat)`

```{r}
#| label: fig-ggplot
dat_sub <- dat |>
    filter(metric =="DMEAN",
           structure == "1_HEART")

ggplot(dat_sub, aes(x=Groesse, y=Gewicht)) +
    geom_point()
```

Verweis auf @fig-ggplot.

# Regression

Fit regression:

```{r echo=FALSE}
fit <- lm(observed ~ GD1 + Seite + haveLAG, data=dat_sub)
```

Coefficient + model tests

```{r}
summary(fit)
```
